new_findings.source_locator: Introduction, paragraph 2: 'Those neurons are of different subtypes...'
new_findings.source_context: Those neurons are of different subtypes that are classified as peptidergic (PEPs), non-peptidergic (NPs), C-LowThreshold mechanoreceptor (C-LTMRs), and a subtype of somatostatin positive neurons (SST)
new_findings.reason: SST is explicitly used by the authors to define and name a nociceptor subtype ('somatostatin positive neurons (SST)'). It is therefore a formal marker for this cell population, not merely a DEG. The paper's primary model is mouse, so the mouse ortholog Sst is used as the normalized symbol.

issues.description: Fig. 1d and Fig. 1h legends state that dot plots show the top 3 gene markers for each of the 18 cell types in iPainDRG and iPainTG, but the actual marker gene names are not present in the Markdown, so these formal markers could not be extracted from the provided text.

The number of Leiden clusters obtained for the nociceptive lineage re-clustering (resolution 0.1) is not reported in the text; only the derived macrostates (woPain/wPain) and five microstates are described.

The SenMayo gene set and SA-beta-galactosidase activity are used to detect senescence in nociceptors, but they are multi-gene signatures or enzymatic assays rather than single-gene markers, and are not recorded as formal marker genes in this review.

task.paper_title: The single-cell transcriptomic atlas iPain identifies senescence of nociceptors as a therapeutical target for chronic pain treatment.
